rules.statement: A person who has divested themselves of all right, title, and interest in a property prior to the institution of a partition action is not a necessary party to the action.
rules.supporting_quote: The petitioner is neither a co-owner of the subject property nor a person presently possessing any. The petitioner has no right, share or interest in the corpus of the Partition Action. The material placed before Court indicates that the petitioner had divested himself of all right, title, and interest in the property prior to the institution of the action.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 5 of the Partition Law No. 21 of 1977 (as amended)
